ldHeroBody: Live crowd predictions for Sri Lanka destinations — plan smarter with explainable risk scores and quieter alternatives.
ldThreeSteps: Three steps to a better trip
ldHeroBodyDetail: Tour Ceylon Live Data predicts crowd density across Sri Lanka's top destinations using a trained Random Forest model — with explainable reasoning behind every prediction.
ldStep1Text: Choose when you're travelling and how much crowding you're willing to tolerate.
ldStep2Text: Our Random Forest model, trained on real visitor and seasonal data, scores expected crowd density for that exact day.
ldStep3Text: Every prediction comes with an explanation — which factors pushed the score up or down — plus how confident the model actually is.
ldFeatureExplainText: Powered by SHAP — see exactly which factors (season, holidays, weather, capacity) shaped each crowd score.
ldFeatureUncertaintyText: Predictions come with a real confidence range, drawn from variance across the model's decision trees — not a fabricated number.
ldFeatureRankingText: Filter by crowd tolerance and budget to see which of 80 real Sri Lankan destinations fit your trip today.
